## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `gofmt -l .` are clean
- [ ] Added/updated a test for non-trivial logic
- [ ] A new detector is high-precision (carries a confidence; suppresses intentional/generated code)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/flags/output changed (README / USAGE.md / `help`)
- [ ] For anything changing output format or the MCP surface: an issue was opened first
